thread:
Maya (Marketing): Quick sync — plan for Beta social + seed list. Want a lightweight X thread, long-form LinkedIn post, 1 LinkedIn image + 1 X carousel. ALSO: seeding to 10 targeted creators. Need owners for copy, assets, seeding list, and paid trigger.
Luis (Growth): I'll own the seeding list. Target: infra devs, ML infra folks, and two product influencers. Will DM the shortlist. Timeline?
Maya (Marketing): Seed list final by Tue EOD. Social goes live Wed 11:00 PST (LI long post) and X thread spread across day.
Priya (Content): I'll draft LI long-form (800-1000 words) emphasizing benchmark narrative: latency vs cost tradeoffs, customer quote, CTA=beta signup. Need benchmark stat and quote from Sam.
Gabe (Design): Assets: 1200x900 hero for LI, 1080x1080 carousel for X (3 slides). I'll re-use the benchmark palette but want a fresh layout. ETA 36h.
Priya (Content): Can someone paste the exact benchmark stat we want to use? Need to avoid absolute $ promises.
Luis (Growth): From the bench doc: median token latency down 60% at 512 tokens vs baseline; throughput increased 2.8x for production mix. Use as: "~60% latency improvement, ~2.8x throughput".
Maya (Marketing): Good. Seed ask: reach out to creators with 1) short explainer + 2) invite to join paid demo. Offer early access badge. Luis will own outreach template.
Luis (Growth): Outreach template draft: "Hi {{name}}, big fan of your work on latency tuning. We're launching Redwood Beta — we'd love to offer you early access and a short demo. Any interest?"
Maya (Marketing): Nice. Ops: how do we route inbound from creator links and promo codes?
OpsBot: New routing rule suggestion: utm_campaign=beta_seed -> queue=creator-inbound; utm_source=creator -> tag=creator. Ops to confirm.
Gabe (Design): Small note: creators may want hi-res PNG and an SVG logo. I'll export both.
Claire (Paid): Paid plan — I'll allocate $1k/day for 3 days as a seed boost, but only trigger if organic CTR > 2% in the first 6 hours or engagement rate > 4% at 6h. Does that work?
Maya (Marketing): Yes. Also want a pinned comment on X linking to a short FAQ + webinar invite. Webinar: Thurs 11:00 PST. Capture attendees with utm_campaign=beta_webinar.
Priya (Content): Sample pinned reply for X: "FAQ + demo slots -> https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_campaign=beta_webinar"
Luis (Growth): For A/B testing: two CTAs on signup push — "Join Beta" vs "Book 15-min demo". Split 60/40 favoring join beta. I'll add utm_content to differentiate.
Maya (Marketing): Good. Please add UTM schema we should use in the tracker.
Luis (Growth): UTM scheme I'll use: utm_source=platform, utm_medium=social, utm_campaign=beta_seed, utm_content={cta_variant}_{asset}

Example CSV for Buffer import:\n```
platform,post_time,variant,utm_source,utm_medium,utm_campaign,utm_content,asset
x,2028-06-21T15:00:00Z,tease,x,social,beta_seed,joinbeta_slide1,carousel-1.png
li,2028-06-21T19:00:00Z,long,linkedin,social,beta_seed,mainhero,hero-li.png
x,2028-06-21T20:00:00Z,signup,x,social,beta_seed,bookdemo_slide3,carousel-3.png
```

Gabe (Design): Uploaded drafts to /assets/social/beta: hero-v1.png, carousel-v1.zip, logo_svg.zip.
Maya (Marketing): Who's monitoring social responses the day of? Need at least 2 folks to triage replies and surface high-intent leads.
Luis (Growth): I'll monitor X. Claire can monitor LI + paid comments. Priya will handle DM copy for follow-ups.
Priya (Content): Quick follow-up DM for high intent: "Thanks for checking Beta — want a quick demo? Pick a slot: https://cal.com/redwood/beta"
Maya (Marketing): Metrics check windows: +3h, +12h, +24h. Claire — if CTR > 2% at +3h, you boost the top-performing post. If not, wait until +12h.
Claire (Paid): Got it. I'll set a watch and a simple rule in the ads console.
Luis (Growth): One more: influencer promo codes. We'll give each creator code like CREATOR10 that adds utm_source=creator and promo=creator10. Ops: can we capture promo in lead record?
OpsBot: Promo field supported. Route: promo -> crm.promo_code. Rule queued for implementation.
Maya (Marketing): Final checklist:
- Assets delivered (Gabe)
- LI long post draft (Priya)
- Seed list & outreach (Luis)
- UTM tracker sheet (Luis)
- Paid watch & boost rules (Claire)
- Routing rules implemented (Ops)

Maya (Marketing): We'll reconvene Tue 10am PT for final signoff. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
